name: Downing Three-Color Display
definition: A volumetric display using glass mixed with rare earth elements as the display space. It generates fluorescent voxels at the intersection of two laser beams (800nm and 1,550nm) via two-step excitation, achieving 3-color volumetric image display.
summary: The Downing Three-Color Display creates true 3D colored images by using two intersecting infrared lasers to trigger two-photon upconversion in rare-earth doped glass, allowing natural ocular accommodation.
